description: Ten factual claims with labels and reference URLs for the tool-augmented vs tool-free verification study (see the 'Research use: claim verification' section of README.md).

claims.claim: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889.
claims.label: true
claims.note: Opened 31 March 1889 for the 1889 World's Fair.

claims.claim: Koalas are a species of bear found only in Australia.
claims.label: false

claims.claim: The Great Wall of China is over 20,000 kilometres long.
claims.label: true
claims.note: Total length including branches is approximately 21,196 km.

claims.claim: The Nile is the longest river in the world.
claims.label: true
claims.note: ~6,650 km; the Amazon vs Nile ranking is debated but the standard reference lists the Nile first.

claims.claim: Mount Everest is 8,849 metres above sea level.
claims.label: true

claims.claim: The first iPhone was released in 2007.
claims.label: true

claims.claim: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
claims.label: true

claims.claim: The capital city of Australia is Sydney.
claims.label: false

claims.claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
claims.label: true

claims.claim: The Amazon river is the only river in the world with river dolphins.
claims.label: false
claims.note: Ganges and Indus river dolphins also exist.
